info.title: Store documentation API
info.description: The documentation site's public, read-only API exports its client search index. It does not provide a hosted Store data API. Unknown /api paths return HTTP 404; unsupported methods on /api/search return HTTP 405 with Allow: GET, HEAD, OPTIONS. API errors use RFC 9457 application/problem+json with code and resolution extensions, as defined in the response components. HEAD responses have no body. Read /llms.txt for the documentation index and /sitemap.xml for page discovery.

get.description: Returns the complete serialized Orama search index for client-side search across Store 5 and Store 6 documentation. Consume it with the Fumadocs oramaStaticClient. The index is generated at build time, and query parameters are ignored; this endpoint does not execute search queries or return a list of search results. The serialized database fields are an implementation format and can change with Fumadocs or Orama upgrades.

200.description: The GET response headers, with no response body.

500.description: The search index could not be generated. This HEAD response has no body.

204.description: Supported methods, with no response body.

Allow.description: Supported methods. Method ordering is not significant.

SearchIndex.description: An opaque Orama database export consumed by Fumadocs oramaStaticClient. It is a database snapshot, not search results.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details. The type URI identifies the problem type; code is a stable site-specific error code and resolution provides recovery guidance. Unknown extension members may be added and must be ignored by clients.

instance.description: The request pathname, without query parameters.

Error404.description: No API endpoint exists at the requested /api path. HEAD requests return these headers and status without a body.

example.title: Not Found
example.detail: This API endpoint does not exist.
example.resolution: Read /openapi.json for the available API, or use /llms.txt and /docs to find documentation.

Error405.description: The requested method is not supported by /api/search.

example.title: Method Not Allowed
example.detail: This API endpoint only supports GET, HEAD, and OPTIONS.
example.resolution: Use GET /api/search to download the search index. Read /openapi.json for its response format.

Error500.description: The documentation search index could not be generated.

example.title: Internal Server Error
example.detail: The documentation search index could not be generated.
example.resolution: Retry later, or use /llms.txt and /docs to find documentation.
